author: codex
message: GOV-002 changes were implemented in the only allowed code paths: tools/roadmap-dashboard/server.mjs now classifies blocked-external-verification entries from explicit blockerType or message convention, exposes blockerType on GET /api/tickets, and rejects POST /api/execute for that blocker unless humanAck:true plus a non-empty ackReason are provided; when acknowledged, it appends an auditable note entry before continuing normal eligibility checks. tools/roadmap-dashboard/index.html now renders the dedicated blocked-external-verification badge and a typed acknowledgment affordance on affected cards. Verification completed locally: `node --check tools/roadmap-dashboard/server.mjs` passed and the inline `<script>` parsed successfully via `new Function()`. Blocking issue is environmental: the sandbox refuses to bind the dashboard listener and exits with `Error: listen EPERM: operation not permitted 127.0.0.1:4570`, so I could not start the dashboard or run the required live GET /api/tickets and POST /api/execute checks against the running UI/API. Unblock requires an environment that permits listening on 127.0.0.1:4570 so the dashboard can run and the live verification commands in GOV-002 can be exercised.

author: claude-sonnet-5
message: Reviewed the prior codex implementation against the ticket spec and fixed one real deviation: the blocked-external-verification/humanAck/ackReason gate in handleExecute() (server.mjs) was placed after the runner/model allowlist checks; moved it to immediately after the isHumanTask check, mirroring FIX-003's gate placement as the architect notes require ('reject before runner/model/dependency logic'). Confirmed by direct file reading (not execution) that everything else matches spec: blockerTypeFromEntry() honors explicit blockerType field first (server.mjs:214-220); foldLedger() carries/clears blockerType (297-330); GET /api/tickets exposes blockerType per card (line 574); the 412 responses for missing humanAck and empty ackReason, and the audit note append on acknowledged requests, are present (lines 745-770); index.html renders the 'bloqueado — verificación externa pendiente' badge and a typed ackReason textarea in place of the Execute control for blocked-external-verification cards (index.html 293-375). Blocked again on live verification: this sandbox's Bash approval gate rejects every node/curl invocation (node --check, node -e parse check, node server.mjs foreground/background) with 'This command requires approval' -- an executor-environment capability gap per ADR-005, same category as FIX-004's browser-session gap, not a code defect. Could not run node --check, start the server, curl /api/tickets to confirm INF-001/FIX-004 carry the blockerType marker, or exercise POST /api/execute's 412/note-append paths. Per ADR-005 and GOV-002's own purpose, do not relaunch this ticket expecting the same sandbox limitation to resolve itself -- unblock needs a human, or an executor whose environment permits node/curl, to run: node --check tools/roadmap-dashboard/server.mjs; start the server; curl 127.0.0.1:PORT/api/tickets (confirm blockerType on INF-001/FIX-004); POST /api/execute for INF-001 with no ack (expect 412), with humanAck:true and empty ackReason (expect 412), and with a real ackReason (expect note appended); then confirm in a real browser that the badge/ack textarea render and that an ordinary genuinely-blocked ticket is unaffected.

author: claude-sonnet-5
message: Third review, no code changes needed. Confirmed server.mjs handleExecute() gate (lines 730-770) placed correctly after isHumanTask check and before runner/model allowlist checks, matching FIX-003 pattern; blockerTypeFromEntry/foldLedger/GET api/tickets blockerType exposure all correct (server.mjs:214-220,297-330,574); index.html badge + ackReason textarea + POST humanAck/ackReason wiring correct (index.html:293-375,464-466). Local node --check rejected by this sandbox Bash approval gate, same environmental limitation as all prior GOV-002 runs and as FIX-004 before its human live-verification close. Recommend human run the live verification (node --check, start server, curl /api/tickets, POST /api/execute negative/positive cases, browser badge/ack check) and then close this ticket via a manual completed ledger entry, same pattern used for FIX-004. Do not relaunch again expecting a different sandbox outcome.
